issues.title: Trace Guide Disconnection
issues.description: The execution tree vertical connector line stays anchored on the left side while trace contents align to the right.
issues.evidence: A vertical guide rail renders on the left edge while step labels and icons align to the right.
issues.suggestion: Mirror tree connector lines and nesting indentations to the right side in RTL mode.
issues.triageNote: Confirmed in source: rail uses physical ml-[18px]/border-l/pl-3 which stay physical-left in RTL while content right-aligns; swapped to logical ms/border-s/ps (mirrors JsonTreeNode rail pattern), rail token moved from neutral-800 (flips bright in dark theme) to border-default-border, and LTR machine-code labels isolated with dir="ltr" against bidi scrambling.
